note: The step-1 curation built against Registerinformation rows that drifted per register (code lists unchanged): choice's row gets a new description (prose); extend and rows each gain a later-year row of the same variable (a new peer); alternatives' second physical row's data_length changes from 10 to 11; alpha's name gains a 'Not ' prefix, so its kategori enumeration no longer matches. Each of those `source_authority` entries is stale; pdf, the two sentinels and support pin no source rows and stay applied. Other guarded registers are not claimed: an authority also pins the Registerinformation revision, so any row change stales every authority in the delivery.
fails_if: `compile_coding_register` stops comparing a `source_authority`'s captured `records` (prose, data length, name) and the column's records (a new peer) with the build's, and stops checking its `revision` (both catch each drift, so both must loosen); or alpha's `SourceEnumeration.matches_fields` stops reading the name; or an entry that pins no source rows (pdf, sentinel, support) starts going stale on an unrelated row's change
